purpose: Bounded eight-pair follow-up pilot plan; no automatic replacement candidates are authorized.

candidates.target_description: the round copper pan hanging above the center-left cooking range
candidates.placement_rationale: The target is visible before generation and the tightened mask stays around the selected hanging pan without covering the cook.
candidates.prompt: a round brass wall clock mounted naturally on the kitchen wall, matching the warm indoor lighting

instruction_review.note: The copper pan is visible. The prior rectangle included more adjacent cookware; the revised rectangle is narrower and excludes the cook.
instruction_review.human_decision_required: Approve or revise the pan-to-clock replacement instruction.

candidates.target_description: the white range hood and honey-colored upper cabinets above the stove and counter
candidates.placement_rationale: The upper fixture group is visible before generation; the large region remains above the foreground table and fruit bowl and avoids the lower stove body.
candidates.prompt: matte navy-blue upper kitchen cabinets with a stainless-steel range hood, realistic residential interior photograph

instruction_review.note: The prior [95,75,415,315] bbox covered 29.296875% and did not satisfy large_over_30pct. Extending its lower edge by 8 px within the same backsplash/upper-fixture context yields 30.273438%, stays above the foreground bowl, and preserves the intended target and quota.
instruction_review.human_decision_required: Approve or revise the upper-cabinet/range-hood replacement.

candidates.target_description: the ceiling area above the living room for a crystal chandelier
candidates.placement_rationale: The flat living room ceiling is visually clear and unobstructed; the 31.25% mask covers the ceiling plane without occluding the walls, armchair, painting, or curtain valance.
candidates.prompt: an elegant crystal chandelier hanging from the living room ceiling, warm interior illumination matching the residential lighting

instruction_review.note: The ceiling is completely flat and unobstructed with zero human or furniture occlusion. The 31.25% mask respects the 30%-50% bracket and leaves all living room fixtures outside the mask.
instruction_review.human_decision_required: Approve proposed candidate substitution of IND_COCO_SDXL_041 (living room ceiling chandelier) replacing blocked candidate IND_COCO_SDXL_001.

candidates.target_description: a small red cherry tomato to insert on the bread slice

candidates.target_description: the foreground forested rocky headland, cliff base, offshore rocks, and pine canopy occupying the lower-right quadrant
candidates.placement_rationale: The foreground headland, cliff, and offshore rocks are identified before removal; the mask completely envelops 100% of the landform, submerged rock base, and pine tree canopy while leaving the sunset sky, horizon, beach, and town outside the mask.
candidates.prompt: open sea and distant coastline continuing naturally through the removed foreground headland, photorealistic sunset landscape

instruction_review.note: The mask extends left to x=190 (enveloping the cliff base at x=205 and offshore rocks) and upward to y=305 (enveloping all pine tree crowns at y>=308). The distant town, hotel, beach, and main horizon remain outside the mask.
instruction_review.human_decision_required: Approve or revise the full foreground headland removal region.

candidates.target_description: a brown leather travel suitcase to insert on the cobblestones beside the car
candidates.placement_rationale: The lower-left cobblestone area is a visible ground plane beside the vehicle; the tightened region stops before the front wheel assembly.
candidates.prompt: a brown leather travel suitcase standing on the cobblestones beside the vintage car, realistic scale and daylight shadows

instruction_review.note: The prior mask clipped the front-wheel boundary despite its rationale. The revised mask remains on cobblestones and ends before the wheel.
instruction_review.human_decision_required: Approve or revise the suitcase size and placement.

candidates.target_description: a small dark bird to insert in the open cloudy sky at upper-right
candidates.placement_rationale: The sky region is visually unobstructed and supports a small airborne object without altering the monument text or sculpture.
candidates.prompt: a small dark bird flying in the cloudy sky, distant scale and natural daylight

instruction_review.note: The registered region is open sky and does not cover the monument, inscription, or sculpture.
instruction_review.human_decision_required: Approve or revise the small-bird insertion instruction.

candidates.target_description: the vertical abstract aluminium sculpture column 'Tower Song' by Ted Bieler
candidates.placement_rationale: The abstract column is a single isolated vertical structure on open park lawn; the large mask envelopes it completely from top to bottom while leaving the lawn, background trees, river, and railing outside the mask.
candidates.prompt: a classical fluted Greco-Roman marble column standing naturally in the public park, realistic outdoor daylight and weathered stone texture

instruction_review.note: The sculpture is a single isolated column with zero human figures or intertwined limbs. The 41.02% mask encloses the entire aluminium structure from top to bottom while preserving the surrounding landscape.
instruction_review.human_decision_required: Approve proposed candidate substitution of IND_COMMONS_SDXL_003 replacing IND_COMMONS_SDXL_002, or retain candidate 002 with explicit confound risk acceptance.
